title: UNIVERSAL SeHub v2
features:
SeHub V2


🔥 What’s Inside

🎯 Combat & Aim
Player ESP — Box, Name, Health bar, Distance, Tracers, and Glow highlights with automatic team-check.

Killaura (Aimbot) — Hold RMB to smoothly lock onto targets. Adjustable FOV, smoothness, wall-check, and target-part selector (Head / Torso).

Hitbox Expander — Increase enemy head size with a live slider (2–500 studs). 
Optional neon red visuals.

TP Fling — Spin-kill nearby players on contact.

🚀 Movement
Camera Fly — Full 6-directional flight with adjustable speed. Hold Ctrl + Mouse 

Wheel to change speed on the fly.

Air Walk — Spawn an invisible platform under your feet anywhere.

Noclip — Walk through any geometry.

FlyJump — Infinite jump boost while active.

WalkSpeed & JumpPower sliders — Instantly tune your mobility (16–250 speed, 50–350 jump).

👻 Visuals & World
Fullbright — Remove shadows and max out lighting globally.

Ghost Invisible — True first-person invisibility with a custom ghost model and 

freecam-style movement.

SpinBot — Rotate at configurable speeds.

Fake Lag — Desync your hitbox with timed anchors.

🧩 Utility & QoL
Teleport — Searchable player list with instant teleport and camera-view toggle. Press C to reset camera to yourself.

Waypoints — Save your current position with a custom name, teleport back anytime, and bind locations to hotkeys.

Array List — Animated, shimmer-gradient list of active modules on the right side of your screen.
🎨 Interface & Config
6 Theme Presets — Orange, Purple, Red, Green, Blue, White.

Custom Accent Color — Drag the rainbow slider to create your own theme and save it permanently.

Per-Module Keybinds — Right-click any toggle to set a hotkey. Press Backspace during binding to clear it.

JSON Config System — All settings, binds, and colors save automatically to SeHub_Config.json.

Safe CoreGui Injection — Bypasses most basic anti-cheat detections via gethui / syn.protect_gui.

Press J to instantly hide/show the entire UI.

Minimize button to collapse the window while keeping all features running.

Live FPS, Ping, and Session Timer in the footer.

⚙️ Quick Setup Notes
Right-click any switch to bind a key. Click again and press Backspace to remove it.

Ctrl + Scroll changes fly speed only while Camera Fly is enabled.

Hold RMB to activate Killaura after turning it on.

Use the Search Player field in the Teleport tab to filter large servers instantly.

Waypoints support individual keybinds — right-click the [...] button next to any saved point.
